cards.example_es: Es ilógico importar fruta que tenemos aquí.
cards.example_en: It's illogical to import fruit we have here.

cards.example_es: Es injusto que paguen menos a las mujeres.
cards.example_en: It's unfair that women are paid less.

cards.example_es: Es intolerable que se tire tanta comida.
cards.example_en: It's intolerable that so much food is thrown away.

cards.example_es: La sequía es un problema grave.
cards.example_en: The drought is a serious problem.

cards.example_es: Es una vergüenza que no haya carril bici.
cards.example_en: It's a disgrace that there's no cycle lane.

cards.example_es: Es una tontería coger el coche para ir a la esquina.
cards.example_en: It's silly to take the car to go round the corner.

cards.example_es: Pagar mil euros por un piso pequeño es una locura.
cards.example_en: Paying a thousand euros for a small flat is madness.

cards.example_es: Es evidente que el clima está cambiando.
cards.example_en: It's evident that the climate is changing.

cards.example_es: Es innegable que hay un problema.
cards.example_en: It's undeniable that there's a problem.

cards.example_es: Es mentira que el plástico se recicle todo.
cards.example_en: It's not true that all plastic is recycled.

cards.example_es: En casa reciclamos el vidrio y el papel.
cards.example_en: At home we recycle glass and paper.

cards.example_es: Reutilizo las bolsas de la compra.
cards.example_en: I reuse shopping bags.

cards.example_es: Hay que reducir el consumo de carne.
cards.example_en: We need to reduce meat consumption.

cards.example_es: Apagando las luces ahorras energía.
cards.example_en: You save energy by turning off the lights.

cards.example_es: El ayuntamiento fomenta el uso de la bici.
cards.example_en: The council encourages cycling.

cards.example_es: Usamos platos biodegradables en la fiesta.
cards.example_en: We used biodegradable plates at the party.

cards.example_es: Este envase es reciclable.
cards.example_en: This packaging is recyclable.

cards.example_es: Compro en el comercio de proximidad.
cards.example_en: I shop at local shops.

cards.example_es: Prohibirán los plásticos de un solo uso.
cards.example_en: They're going to ban single-use plastics.

cards.example_es: Las maquinillas de usar y tirar generan mucha basura.
cards.example_en: Disposable razors create a lot of rubbish.

cards.example_es: Me he comprado una bici de segunda mano.
cards.example_en: I've bought a second-hand bike.

cards.example_es: Llevo una botella de acero inoxidable.
cards.example_en: I carry a stainless-steel bottle.

cards.example_es: Los envases de vidrio se pueden reutilizar.
cards.example_en: Glass containers can be reused.

cards.example_es: Generamos demasiados residuos.
cards.example_en: We produce too much waste.

cards.example_es: Andalucía sufre una sequía muy dura.
cards.example_en: Andalusia is suffering a very severe drought.

cards.example_es: Solo compro café de comercio justo.
cards.example_en: I only buy fair-trade coffee.

cards.example_es: Hago voluntariado en un comedor social.
cards.example_en: I volunteer at a soup kitchen.

cards.example_es: Donamos la ropa que ya no usamos.
cards.example_en: We donate the clothes we no longer wear.

cards.example_es: Hay que concienciar a la población.
cards.example_en: We need to raise people's awareness.

cards.example_es: Yo que tú, iría en tren.
cards.example_en: If I were you, I'd go by train.

cards.example_es: El principal problema es el tráfico.
cards.example_en: The main problem is traffic.

cards.example_es: Hay que buscar una solución.
cards.example_en: We have to find a solution.

cards.example_es: Propongo crear más carriles bici.
cards.example_en: I propose creating more cycle lanes.

cards.example_es: Es una propuesta interesante.
cards.example_en: It's an interesting proposal.

cards.example_es: Queremos mejorar la calidad del aire.
cards.example_en: We want to improve air quality.

cards.example_es: La situación ha empeorado.
cards.example_en: The situation has got worse.

cards.example_es: Evito coger el coche en el centro.
cards.example_en: I avoid taking the car in the centre.

cards.example_es: No tires las pilas a la basura.
cards.example_en: Don't throw batteries in the bin.

cards.example_es: En casa separamos la basura.
cards.example_en: At home we sort our rubbish.

cards.example_es: El contenedor amarillo es para plásticos.
cards.example_en: The yellow bin is for plastics.

cards.example_es: Usamos demasiado plástico.
cards.example_en: We use too much plastic.

cards.example_es: Siempre llevo una bolsa de tela.
cards.example_en: I always carry a cloth bag.

cards.example_es: Hay que reducir el gasto de agua.
cards.example_en: We need to reduce water consumption.

cards.example_es: No desperdicies la comida.
cards.example_en: Don't waste food.

cards.example_es: El desperdicio de alimentos es enorme.
cards.example_en: Food waste is enormous.

cards.example_es: Uso el transporte público todos los días.
cards.example_en: I use public transport every day.

cards.example_es: Compartimos coche para ir al trabajo.
cards.example_en: We car-share to get to work.

cards.example_es: El edificio funciona con energía solar.
cards.example_en: The building runs on solar power.

cards.example_es: Es un hotel sostenible.
cards.example_en: It's a sustainable hotel.

cards.example_es: Es necesario actuar ya.
cards.example_en: It's necessary to act now.

cards.example_es: Me parece injusto.
cards.example_en: I think it's unfair.

cards.example_es: Me parece bien que cierren el centro al tráfico.
cards.example_en: I think it's good they're closing the centre to traffic.

cards.example_es: Es una pena que cierren la biblioteca.
cards.example_en: It's a shame they're closing the library.

cards.example_es: Es lógico que la gente proteste.
cards.example_en: It's understandable that people protest.

cards.example_es: Está claro que hay que cambiar.
cards.example_en: It's clear we have to change.

cards.example_es: Es verdad que reciclamos más que antes.
cards.example_en: It's true we recycle more than before.

cards.example_es: Es falso que el reciclaje no sirva.
cards.example_en: It's false that recycling is useless.

cards.example_es: ¿Has oído lo de la nueva ley?
cards.example_en: Have you heard about the new law?

cards.example_es: Lo peor es el ruido.
cards.example_en: The worst thing is the noise.

cards.example_es: Deberíamos consumir menos.
cards.example_en: We should consume less.
